name: language-steps
description: Language Steps: Chinese and Japanese learning app (static PWA with Supabase).

scripts.test: node tools/validate-content.js && node tests/smoke.js && node tests/sync.test.js && node tests/features.test.js && node tests/kanji.test.js && node tests/casual.test.js
scripts.format: prettier --write tools tests .claude docs README.md CLAUDE.md
scripts.dict:get: gh release download --repo scriptin/jmdict-simplified --pattern "jmdict-eng-[0-9]*.json.zip" --dir tmp/dict --clobber && unzip -o -q "tmp/dict/jmdict-eng-*.json.zip" -d tmp/dict
